subject.title: Add bounded PR detail fill command

question: Must `--reserve-rate-limit` strictly preserve the configured remaining quota, or should it be an explicitly best-effort pre-batch threshold that may overshoot?
rationale: The current flag name implies a stronger guarantee than the implementation provides, and choosing strict enforcement versus weaker documented semantics is a public product-contract decision.

options.title: Strictly preserve the reserve
options.body: Add request-budget or in-batch stopping support so hydration cannot consume below the configured quota reserve.

options.title: Document best-effort behavior
options.body: Rename and document the option so users understand that a started batch may consume below the threshold.

options.title: Remove the reserve option
options.body: Land bounded selection and progress without quota-reserve behavior until the sync layer supports a clear guarantee.

recommendation.title: Strictly preserve the reserve
recommendation.body: Add request-budget or in-batch stopping support so hydration cannot consume below the configured quota reserve.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the PR-detail hydration and shared rate-limit mechanisms whose contract this feature combines.
